description: None of the five context folders contain anything beyond (at most) the standing README template — no real financial, operational, market, technical, or people data is provided for a decision this size. Every subagent should have too little to go on.
notes: This is the one example where a fully empty context/<role>/ folder is staged for the run (the standing README.md is removed for the duration of the run and restored afterward), directly exercising each agent's literal instruction: 'if the folder is empty, return insufficient_data.' decision.md deliberately states no country/region/city and is tagged jurisdiction: unspecified, so regulatory_context_consulted must be false and the saudi-law-tracker Bash step must never be invoked at all. Four escalating prompt-only fixes (2026-09-15) all failed to reliably prevent the CEO from inferring or assuming Saudi jurisdiction anyway -- see VALIDATION_REPORT.md. EC-02 deterministic-gate follow-up (2026-09-15): replaced free-text jurisdiction inference with a mechanical jurisdiction: field read (council.md step 1) that the CEO is instructed to look up rather than derive; check (e) now also verifies the actual Bash tool invocation from the raw transcript, not just the CEO's self-reported regulatory_context_consulted field, so a self-report can't mask (or falsely claim) an unjustified regulatory consult.
